source_snapshot.procedure: Match recipe; clear logs; change all/random APM settings; save/reboot and confirm retention; Load Defaults/save/reboot and confirm SPEC; collect photos/logs.
source_snapshot.criteria: No errors or reboot failure; changed setting persists; default matches SPEC.
source_snapshot.script: No bundle; 5 attended/20 machine minutes; unique row/variant.
source_snapshot.deepseek: NO; correctly requires manual BIOS interaction but omits control-specific power, thermal and protection effects.
source_snapshot.gpt_v2: MANUAL ONLY/HIGH; required safe APM values, expected-effect telemetry, protection invariants, KVM recovery and preserved evidence.

old_problem: The historical record awaited APM defaults, safe values, power/thermal acceptance and recovery because Master requests all/random modification and log clearing.
disposition_reason: The approved BIOS rule establishes reversible one-setting-at-a-time execution and prohibits all/random changes. For APM, each selected control is bound to expected power, frequency, idle, thermal, throttle, fan and protection behavior with independent monitoring. Exact limits and recovery are runtime project configuration; protections may never be disabled or guessed.
decision_basis: XLSX row 2182, same-row DeepSeek columns, GPT V2, historical record, unique identity and ED-01 through ED-30 were reviewed; actual next formal row Functionality 2183 / Wistron-BIOS-00500-V003 / 4c7fbdc3588f638c was directly read from XLSX, manifest and historical record.
Reject all/random; approve one reversible APM control or coherent dependency group with documented expected effects.
Bind CPU/board/BIOS/BMC, calibrated sensors, cooling and project power envelope.
Never disable thermal/current/voltage protections; compare idle/load power, frequency, temperature, throttling and fan behavior.
Qualified operator controls KVM save/reboot/Load-Defaults with an independent observer and physical recovery.
Preserve BMC/SEL/kernel/thermal evidence; define workload, cadence, hard aborts and recovery before change.
No BIOS/APM setting, workload, telemetry state, log, reboot, Load Defaults, recovery or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_name: Controlled Advanced Power Management persistence, envelope and default-restoration validation
test_case.purpose: Verify each approved reversible APM control persists and restores to Project SPEC while effective power, frequency/idle, thermal, throttling, fan and protection behavior remains inside the qualified platform envelope.
required_package: Qualified BIOS/KVM operator, independent observer and maintenance window
Project-default and effect-aware reversible APM matrix
Approved workload, telemetry cadence and power/thermal/fan limits
Last-known-good, hard-abort and KVM/physical/CMOS recovery plan
test_case.test_command: Operator captures baseline APM page and calibrated telemetry, changes one approved reversible control or dependency group, saves/reboots, proves retention and measures the signed idle/load effect, then performs approved Load Defaults and repeats page and telemetry comparisons. Monitor protections continuously and stop immediately on any hard limit or instability.
test_case.expected_result: Each approved control persists; every phase meets signed boot, power, frequency/idle, temperature, throttle, fan, protection and error criteria; after Load Defaults the page and effective platform envelope equal Project SPEC.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: PASS only for the approved matrix when screenshots and all signed effective-behavior limits match. Protection loss, power/thermal excursion, unexpected throttling/fan behavior, instability or disallowed error is FAIL. Missing runtime limit/value/recovery oracle is BLOCKED.
safety_gate: Gate CLOSED until platform/sensor/cooling identity, values/effects, workload, hard limits and recovery are signed.
Never execute all/random or disable thermal/current/voltage protections.
Independent monitoring remains active; preserve BMC/SEL/kernel/thermal evidence and do not clear logs.
Operator controls save/reboot/Load-Defaults/recovery; no automatic retry or CMOS clear.
expected_evidence: Exact row/variant/hash, authorization and platform/power/cooling identity
Signed default/value/dependency/expected-effect matrix and protection list
Baseline, changed, retained, Load-Defaults and restored screenshots
Per-phase workload, power, frequency/idle, temperature, throttle and fan telemetry
Restored safe envelope, discrepancy/recovery record and engineer verdict
test_case.recovery: Stop immediately on protection loss, excursion, instability or no-boot and preserve evidence. Qualified personnel restore the last-known-good policy via KVM or signed physical/CMOS recovery; do not clear evidence or automatically reboot/retry.

source_conflict.reason: Target and acceptance consistently cover APM persistence/default restoration; unsafe all/random wording is constrained without dropping effective power/thermal coverage.

blocked.reason: Safe effect-aware APM method is clear; exact values, limits and recovery are runtime inputs.

pending.remaining_project_configuration: CPU/board/BIOS/BMC/sensor/cooling identity, Project SPEC defaults, reversible APM values/effects, workload/telemetry/limits, Load-Defaults scope and recovery.
pending.execution_status: REVIEW RESOLVED AS PARAMETERIZED MANUAL TEST; RUNTIME PROJECT CONFIGURATION AND EXPLICIT CONFIRMATION REQUIRED; NO BIOS, WORKLOAD, LOG, REBOOT, DEFAULT, RECOVERY OR DUT ACTION EXECUTED
pending.owner: BIOS/power-thermal platform owner and qualified KVM/physical operator
pending.unlock_condition: Populate and sign effect-specific values, envelope limits and recovery before execution; absence blocks execution but not review resolution.

external_authorities.authority: User-approved ED-11 BIOS safety principle and ED-01 through ED-30
external_authorities.application: Uses approved one-setting-at-a-time execution while preserving APM-specific effective telemetry and all protection gates.

project_authority: BIOS/power-thermal owner signs controls, envelope and recovery; operator/observer perform manual workflow; end engineer owns verdict.
